title: Jumerra — National Talent Infrastructure for Early-Career Employment
description: Title slide: proposal cover for the Ministry of Technology, in partnership with Education and Labour.

title: Executive summary
description: The full argument in four statements: an operational platform, the data it produces, the per-ministry function, and the ask.

title: Early-career hiring is fragmented across candidates, employers, and institutions
description: The problem context: gaps for graduates, employers, institutions, and government, spread across three mandates.

title: Jumerra is an operational three-sided platform with a dedicated government layer
description: What Jumerra is: candidates, employers, institutions, and a government layer, already running across web, mobile, and API.

title: Matching ranks candidates by skills, experience, and verified talent signals
description: The matching model: a 65/15/20 weighting bar plus endorsement, verification, and explainability points.

title: The Ministry of Technology gains sovereign digital employment infrastructure
description: Value to the Ministry of Technology, with an architecture diagram of the three sources, platform, and three ministries.

title: The Ministry of Education gains real-time visibility into student placement
description: Value to the Ministry of Education: verification, placement tracking, employer engagement, and live dashboards.

title: The Ministry of Labour gains live labour-market intelligence
description: Value to the Ministry of Labour: market overview, skills signals, salary insights, and aggregate-only dashboards.

title: Access is role-scoped and ministry dashboards expose only aggregates
description: Governance, privacy, and security: role scoping, aggregate-only ministry access, and code-enforced boundaries.

title: The three ministries share one platform under separate mandates
description: A comparison table of the three ministries: mandate and what each one gains, with no overlap in authority.

title: Adoption proceeds in four phases, from pilot to national rollout
description: A four-phase adoption timeline from Ministry of Technology endorsement through national rollout.

title: The ask: endorse, onboard, and pilot Jumerra
description: Closing ask: specific commitments from each ministry plus a time-boxed pilot and the closing tagline.
